answer: Pay referral bonuses out of fees actually collected from referred buyers. In a lagoon marketplace for pearl surveys, a verified purchase is the signal to credit the referrer, and each purchase ID can fund only one bonus. If a farmer creates both buyer and seller accounts, the sale price comes back to the farmer but the fee does not. A bonus of at most half that fee leaves every self-funded trade at a loss. Delay payout until the refund window closes so cancelled purchases cannot fund bonuses.
